# inid.me — Smart AR Business Card & Offline vCard Platform
> Documentation, API Schema & Knowledge Graph for LLMs, AI Agents & Search Crawlers.
> Follows Gravatar llms.txt standard: https://docs.gravatar.com/guides/llms-txt/
> Structured Schema.org: https://schema.org/Person, https://schema.org/ContactPoint

## Project Identity & Spirit
- **Name**: inid.me (Identity In ID)
- **Tagline**: Smart AR Business Card • Offline vCard & NFC Protocol
- **Vision**: Bridging zero-network physical networking (<480B NTAG215 / vCard 3.0 static QR) with interactive 3D WebXR and Apple AR Quick Look / Android Scene Viewer.
- **Hosted**: 100% Static Web on GitHub Pages + Cloudflare Edge CDN.
- **Privacy & Security**: Zero tracking, zero database, 100% client-side cryptographic URL hash (#data=...).

## Features for Agents & LLM Analyzers
1. **Offline Mode (<480B vCard 3.0)**:
   - Contains strictly essential contact fields: `FN`, `ORG`, `TITLE`, `TEL`, `EMAIL`, `ADR`, `URL`.
   - Strips social networks and heavy assets from the offline vCard payload to guarantee instant camera scanning and 100% fit on NTAG215 NFC chips (504 bytes physical limit, 496B NDEF limit).
2. **Online 2-Sided AR Mode**:
   - Front Side: Personal identity, telephone, email, avatar, and dynamic social profiles (Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, LinkedIn, GitHub, X, YouTube, Zalo).
   - Back Side: Company identity, verified website, corporate address, brand tagline, logo.
   - Dual-layout rendering: Vertical (Portrait) & Horizontal (Landscape) CSS 3D Flip Card with 1-tap spatial AR model placement.
3. **URL & Username Optimization**:
   - Automatic protocol normalization (enforcing HTTPS on frontend).
   - Regex-based short handle parser (e.g. `facebook.com/username` -> `username`).
4. **i18n Architecture**:
   - Client-side static dictionary supporting 27 international languages.

## Endpoints & Schemas
- CMS Studio: `https://inid.me/edit/`
- Card Viewer: `https://inid.me/#data=<base64-profile>`
- LLM Spec: `https://inid.me/llms.txt`
- Brand Logos: `https://inid.me/assets/logo-concept-1.svg` (Portal), `logo-concept-2.svg` (Infinity), `logo-concept-3.svg` (3D Prism)
